inventory_summary: Inventoried 121 authored WallBacking bands (130 resolved runs), 400+ wall-mounted bodies vs absolute z, 213 stud crossings for R602.6, 3 fireblocks, towel/TP sources (Moen specs cited; spec PDF fetch unreadable). Sheets read: S-101.1-.3 (floor framing, no backing shown), S-601, A-507, A-553/554/558/565/570/572/578/584. NOT examined: A-555..A-584 remaining, Kohler mirror rails, TANNFORSEN product data, plate-cut ties, joist bores (R502.8), furring.py. IKEA Sektion rail is 2 1/8 in. tall (bands 7.25 in. generous).
verified_clean: Band heights equal profile depth for all 121 WallBacking (integrity.wall_backing_ref)
Moen towel/TP fixing points land on bands or studs (30 posts pass); absolute z coverage clean except EVSE
Stud bore limits 40/60%, 25/40% notch, 5/8 in. edge and 50% plate rule match R602.6/R602.6.1
Bores graded with true ODs (1.9, 2.375, 3.5 in.); 210 of 213 stud crossings pass
Bands break at headers/sills (no band overlaps a header or sill); only hydrant penetrations cross RO voids
No wall cavity exceeds 10 ft so no horizontal R302.11 block needed
Fireblock chases use 3/4 in. ply and 3.5 in. mineral wool

findings.title: BK-G-S-EVSE sits 22 in. above the EVSE it backs (authored AFF, framed from wall base)

evidence.measured: Garage floor -34 in., W-G-S base_ref_z -12 in. (framing sits on ICF stem). EVSE body abs z 8.0..18.25 (Mount 42 in. AFF = 42..52.25 AFF). Resolved band backing-0-000 abs z 29.5..40.75 (63.5..74.75 AFF), stations 168.8..191.3 cover the EVSE station 186. Gap: band bottom 11.25 in. above EVSE top.
evidence.expected: Band abs z 8..19 or wider (elevation 19.5 in. from wall base for 42 in. AFF, i.e. 41.5-22).
evidence.method: Load model; compare o.body_z0/z1 of APPL-G-EVSE with W-G-S members 'backing-*' z0/z1 (scratchpad geometry-review/F2/ (pickled model m.pkl from load_plan+resolve; probes p6.py, p8.py, p18.py)).

findings.source: Comment at backing.py:353 'EVSE four screws 42..52 1/4 in.' (AFF)
findings.proposed_fix: Set elevation=inch(19.5) (41.5 minus 22 in. stem), height 11.25; recheck advisory.wall_backing_present passes against absolute z.

findings.title: advisory.wall_backing_present compares Mount.elevation (AFF) to band elevation (wall-base datum) directly

evidence.measured: Bodies stand at finished floor + mount: main +0.94 in., basement +0.75 in., second +1.5 in., garage +22 in. relative to wall base_ref. Check uses low=mount.elevation vs b.elevation_m with 1 in. reach, so it passed APPL-G-EVSE (11 in. miss) as 'backed'. Only the garage is out of tolerance today; others shift bands 0.75-1.5 in. low (grab course 32-39.25 becomes 30.5-37.75 AFF on second floor).
evidence.expected: Compare absolute body z0/z1 (o.body_z0_m/body_z1_m) or add finished-floor offset of the wall's room to band elevation.
evidence.method: p3.py/p8.py: for every wall-mounted canvas object compare abs body z range to resolved 'backing-' members; only EVSE fails. Offsets from model.canvas_objects z_m - mount.elevation.

findings.source: IRC R328.1.1 (32-39.25 in. above floor) via notes/wall_backing.md
findings.proposed_fix: Convert band elevation by room finished-floor offset in check, or fix the check to read absolute z; consider a check of the resolved member not authored run.

findings.title: Continuous backing bands run through 3 in. stacks and a 4 in. duct standing in the same bay

evidence.measured: Plan-and-z overlap of run envelope with band footprint: PR-M-S-BATH1-DRAIN (3.5 in. OD, x=60 in., z -22..123) overlaps BK-M-STOS-SHELF (no start/length, whole 72 in. wall, z 64..71.25) by 3.93 sq in. on a 2x4 wall (3.5 in. cavity); PR-M-S-SUITE-DRAIN overlaps backing-1 (46..53.2) and backing-3 (86..93.2) of W-M-CLN by 0.84 sq in. each; DU-M-ERV-R-LAUNDRY 4 in. overlaps BK-M-CLN2-PAX band by 1.63 sq in. Note wall_backing.md s5 admits nothing grades band vs pipe.
evidence.expected: Bands break at the stack bay (author start/length around the run) or the stack moves.
evidence.method: p18.py: swept run envelope (run_polylines/run_sections) intersect Polygon(member_footprint(backing member)) with z overlap.

findings.proposed_fix: Split BK-M-STOS-SHELF/-CLN-RACK/-PAX around the stack and duct bays; add a run-vs-backing check.

findings.title: 3 in. DWV (3.5 in. OD) stack through a 2x4 partition plate is graded UNKNOWN, not FAIL

evidence.measured: W-M-STOS INT_2X4_PARTITION_HALF: 3.5 in. structure, plates 3.5 in. wide; stack at (60,319.5) is 3.5 in. OD (hub ~4.2 in.) through plate-top-0/1 and sole plate. stud_bore/top_plate_cut return None for diameter >= depth ('framed opening with header'); checks.json: mep.run_through_plate UNKNOWN for PR-M-S-BATH1-DRAIN. No header or opening is framed.
evidence.expected: A stack as wide as the wall is a build conflict (2x6 wall or furred chase) and should FAIL, or the wall carries an authored opening/chase.
evidence.method: p10.py crossing census (3 UNKNOWN of 213 stud crossings) + p11.py wall/plate dims; checks.json mep.run_through_plate.

findings.proposed_fix: Treat penetration >= depth with no framed opening/header in the model as FAIL; fix W-M-STOS (2x6) or chase.

findings.title: PR-A-STUBATH-DRAIN 3.5 in. stack lands on stud-005 of W-S-DC2

evidence.measured: Stack at (115.5,232), z 231.5..116, radius 1.75 in.; stud-005 2x4 at (116.5,231.0) z 121.5..224.4 overlaps in plan by 1.5 in. along wall; check says UNKNOWN 'wider than 3.5 in. depth'.
evidence.expected: Stack stands in a clear bay (stud shifted) or flagged FAIL.

findings.proposed_fix: Shift stud-005 or the stack ~2 in.; same engine fix as F2-004.

findings.title: Backing bands are modelled as continuous boards through every stud (380 overlaps) though the note says fitted between studs

evidence.measured: 130 band runs overlap 380 stud/king/jack footprints by the full 1.5 in. band thickness (e.g. W-M-HS1 backing-2 across stud-002/004). Let into a stud that would be 1.5/3.5=43% (2x4) or 27% (2x6 exterior) vs R602.6 notch 25%/40%. Takeoff bills the full run LF (2x8 316 LF) with no stud deduction (~9% over).
evidence.expected: Per-bay blocks (as s4 says) or a model that shows the board stopping at stud faces.
evidence.method: p19.py intersect Polygon(member_footprint) band vs studs.

findings.proposed_fix: Cut band runs at stud faces in the resolver (billing and drawing then match).

findings.title: Bore check treats only joist-bearing walls as bearing; exterior and roof-bearing walls get 60%

evidence.measured: bearing_wall_tags = foundation + JoistSpec.bearing_refs. Exterior EXT_2X6 walls W-M-W3, W-M-N1, W-M-N3, W-A-N2 (wall_is_exterior True) are graded non-bearing (60% = 3.30 in.); R602.6 gives exterior walls 40% (2.20 in.). Largest OD there is 1.9 in. so no verdict changes today; PR-A-BAR-VENT (2.375 in.) on W-A-BATH-S would flip if that wall bears roof.
evidence.expected: Exterior walls and walls carrying roof/beam/post loads use 40%/25%.
evidence.method: p10.py walls with bearing False + wall_is_exterior.

findings.proposed_fix: Add wall_is_exterior and roof/beam bearing to bearing_wall_tags.

findings.title: Title/legend text piled on itself at the left of ~20 stack-shelf and rim-band detail sheets

evidence.measured: A-554 (p89) shows 'Catlin House / derived transition detail / MATERIALS' overprinted illegibly on the detail; A-570 (p105) same pile left of the detail. Same text pattern on pages 47,50,54,58,64,65,68,69,71,74,80,89,90,94,97,105,121-124. The rim-band details also carry no dimension strings.
evidence.expected: Legend and title laid out clear of the drawing.
evidence.method: pdftotext -raw grep 'derived transition detail' per page; visual check of p89, p105.

findings.proposed_fix: Fix the transition-detail legend placement in the detail sheet emitter.

findings.title: No R302.11 fireblock note or detail for soffits, drop ceilings and stair stringers

evidence.measured: Engine models fireblocks only for 3 floor chases (FO-M-ERV-OA etc., 3 in. mineral wool and 3/4 in. ply, passes). Set text mentions fire blocking only at duct bearing-wall crossings. 3 soffits and 6 stairs exist; no wall exceeds 10 ft cavity (max stud run 114.5 in.).
evidence.expected: A general note (R302.11 items 2-4) on the framing sheets.

findings.proposed_fix: Add a general note on S-sheets.

findings.title: wall_backing.md says walls take 5/8 in. gypsum; catlin walls are 1/2 in.

evidence.measured: Resolved interior finish layer 0.5 in. (GWB_LINING_HALF, 'catlin walls are 1/2 in., ceilings 5/8'); note s4 and backing.py say 5/8 in. gypsum on studs. Garage 0.625 in.

findings.title: Wall-backing coverage check never reads Equipment or ElectricalDevice (meter-main 36 in. tall on a framed exterior wall)

evidence.measured: WallMountedBody = Furniture|Fixture|Appliance. ED-M-METER (Mount elevation 0, body 0..36 in.) on W-M-W1 EXT_2X6 has no band; utility meter sockets need a rigid backer. Not graded. Confidence low: mounting through 4 in. foam and girts may be solved by the supplier.
evidence.expected: A band or backer plate behind heavy exterior-mounted devices.
evidence.method: p21.py listing of wall-mounted Equipment/ED on framed walls.

findings.proposed_fix: Extend the check to Equipment/ElectricalDevice or document backer.

findings.title: S-601 bills the same lumber under two size names (1.5x11.25 and 2x12)

evidence.measured: Cut list has '1.5x11.25 blocking 3 pcs 5 LF' beside '2x12 blocking 4 pcs 11 LF'; also a poplar '0.75x3.5 blocking' trim board in the framing order.
